english.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a chart showing data.
Use this for a graph or chart, especially one displaying data or change over time.
Use 圖表 as the all-purpose noun for a visual diagram or graph, rather than a data table.

examples.english: This graph clearly shows the sales for each month this year.
examples.traditional: 呢張圖表清楚顯示今年每個月嘅銷量。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 biu2 cing1 co2 hin2 si6 gam1 nin4 mui5 go3 jyut6 ge3 siu1 loeng6

examples.english: This diagram shows the sales figures for the past five years.
examples.traditional: 呢個圖表顯示過去五年嘅銷售額。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou4 biu2 hin2 si6 gwo3 heoi3 ng5 nin4 ge3 siu1 sau6 ngaak6

examples.english: This chart is clear at a glance.
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 biu2 jat1 tai2 zau6 ming4
